what: the percentile contrast window in detect_cracks.load_as_uint8 -- Figure 6's constant F -- swept on full frames against the hand-painted correction masks
why_no_tile_arm: tilebench.build_cache takes its percentiles over the 512 px CROP while detect_cracks.load_as_uint8 takes them over the WHOLE micrograph, so a tile re-stretch is per-tile autocontrast, not this constant. Measured per tile in tile_control below; the script RAISES if the two windows agree. A corollary: the cached img8 is not byte-identical to what the pipeline sees, contrary to build_cache's docstring.
scoring: correction masks: 1 = crack, 2 or 3 = not-crack, 0 excluded
stage_scored: candidate stage: load -> find_field_of_view -> flatten_background(sigma=40) -> shipped 7-rung segment_dark_regions | (img8 < 10) -> clean_mask(min_area_px=13) -> components >= 40 px. The region classifier is NOT applied, matching ladder_endpoints_frames.py.
pixel_grid: every setting is scored inside the SHIPPED field-of-view box so that 'pixels deleted' is defined; find_field_of_view is itself downstream of this constant and its box per setting is reported in fov_box_changed_on_frames and per_frame[].settings[].fov_box
frame_selection: up to 2 per specimen, NOT alphabetical, PLUS every painted frame in common.GENTLE_CONTRAST_IMAGES -- the three the shipped pipeline already runs at (0.0, 100.0) by hand. The two unit sets are pooled separately: pooled_roundrobin and pooled_gentle_contrast_frames. 'settings' at the top level is the round-robin sample.

mechanism.note: flatten_background's own percentile re-stretch and segment_dark_regions' otsu / median-MAD cut are all affine-EQUIVARIANT, so on unclipped floats this constant would select the identical relative mask at every setting. Its whole effect runs through saturation (sat_lo_pct, sat_hi_pct), uint8 quantisation, and the ABSOLUTE gate img8 < 10, which compares a rescaled value to a fixed number and is the only non-equivariant stage. gate_px is that stage's own size per setting, so no row may claim an effect larger than its mechanism.
mechanism.clamping: a percentile is clamped by the data: on a frame with more than low_pct percent of its pixels at the raw floor every low_pct in this grid returns the same lo, and the rows are byte-identical. See n_frames_identical_img8_to_default and per_frame[].n_distinct_img8_over_grid.

direction.why: this constant sets the 8-bit values that the absolute gate (img8 < 10) and every Otsu/MAD cut in the ladder compare against, so moving it moves pixels in BOTH directions. It is not a union-widening change like adding a ladder rung, and it CAN delete a pixel a human painted as crack. painted_crack_deleted_vs_shipped is that count, per setting pooled and per frame.
direction.measured: non-zero painted_crack_deleted_vs_default on 35 of 35 non-default settings, round-robin sample

controls.tile_arm_is_impossible: MEASURED, raises if the tile windows agree

caveats: recall here is the CANDIDATE stage's recall and the candidate stage marks 10.5% of the frame at the shipped setting; read every recall against pct_of_frame_marked and lift_over_mark_everything or a setting that merely paints more will look like an improvement
n frames is small and the not-crack paint is far scarcer than the crack paint, so rate_on_painted_notcrack is weak evidence about precision
no leave-one-specimen-out selector is run: with 36 settings on 13 frames the fitted argmax is not a held-out result and is not quoted as one

the three GENTLE_CONTRAST frames are scored against the (1.0, 99.5) default as their baseline, NOT against their own (0.0, 100.0) override, so that 'deleted vs default' means the same thing in every row
